<section_guide number="3" title="Primary User Scenario">
<purpose>Turn the product idea into one representative journey that the mockup or PoC can demonstrate.</purpose>

<questions>
1. What starts the primary user's journey, and what result marks completion?
2. What are the three to eight essential steps between those points?
</questions>

<workflow>
Draft a table with user action, product response, and expected result for each step. Keep one main
flow. Include at most two interruptions that materially affect the PoC. Do not expand every error
or alternative journey here.
</workflow>

<completion required="true">Confirm the complete scenario and observable completion result before saving.</completion>
</section_guide>
